loe.note: No specific LOE year verified. In the company Q2 FY27 call on 30 October 2026, an analyst asked whether Ilumya LOE should be 2030 or later with secondary protection; management answered only that it was not in the foreseeable future. The analyst-suggested 2030 is not company guidance or an FDA-determined exclusivity expiration.
loe.note_zh: 未核实具体的独占期结束年份。在公司2027财年第二季度2026年10月30日的电话会上,有分析师询问Ilumya的独占期结束是否应为2030年或更晚(含二级保护);管理层仅回答近期不会发生。分析师提出的2030年并非公司指引,也不是FDA确定的独占期到期日。
